title: Concessive Relative Clauses with bárki (... is) and bármilyen (... is)

sections.title: Subject and Oblique Concessive Clauses: Bárki ült is vele szemben...
sections.content: When bárki or akárki introduces a concessive subordinate clause ('whoever / no matter who...'), the pronoun stands at the head of the clause, immediately followed by the finite verb and the particle is: Bárki ült is vele szemben a sakktáblánál, Judit győzelemre tört ('Whoever sat across from her at the chessboard, Judit strove for victory').

sections.title: Adjectival Concessives: Bármilyen + Adjective/Adverb + Verb + is
sections.content: Similarly, bármilyen ('no matter what kind of / however...') modifies an adjective or adverb right before the verb, with is placed right after the verb: Bármilyen szkeptikusan fogadták is a kísérletet, az eredmények igazolták a szülőket ('However skeptically they received the experiment, the results vindicated the parents').

sections.title: Concessive Clause Templates
rows: Bárki ült is vele szemben, bátran támadott.
Whoever sat across from her, she attacked boldly.
Bármilyen erős volt is az ellenfél, nem hátrált meg.
However strong the opponent was, she did not retreat.
Bármilyen szkeptikusan fogadták is a tervet, sikeres lett.
However skeptically they received the plan, it became successful.

items.spanish: Bárki ült is vele szemben a sakktábla túloldalán, Polgár Judit támadó stílusban játszott.
items.english: Whoever sat across from her on the other side of the chessboard, Judit Polgár played in an attacking style.

items.spanish: Bármilyen szkeptikusan fogadták is kezdetben a pedagógiai kísérletet, a három lány sikere mindenkit meggyőzött.
items.english: However skeptically the pedagogical experiment was initially received, the three daughters' success convinced everyone.

items.spanish: Bármelyik világbajnokkal mérkőzött is meg, egyenrangú ellenfélnek bizonyult.
items.english: Whichever world champion she competed against, she proved to be an equal opponent.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Notice how any preverb on the verb inside a bárki/bármelyik ... is clause must invert after the particle is: Bármelyik világbajnokkal mérkőzött is meg (from megmérkőzik).
